items.title: Please add amusement park DLC
items.text:
Please add amusement park DLC
Hello!

I am really loving Tropico 6 and especially the tourism aspect is interesting. There is a lot of diversity with how you can do tourism although I feel there aren't enough actual attractions.

I think the coaster is cool but it's lame to put more than one since it's the same every time.

I'd love to see a DLC that adds 10+ new attractions such as ferris wheel, alternate coasters, fun house, etc.

I think it would be cool to design a big amusement park on my islands. Yeah I know Planet Coaster is for managing parks and I do love that game so I'd really love to do it within Tropico 6.

Perhaps also have some options for water rides too and that sort of thing.


A ski resort would be interesting as well (indoor ski resort).
